parts.title: Venue Booking Form
parts.transcriptHtml:
Staff Member (Pete): Hi. Good morning. My name's Pete. How can I help you?

Maria Lincoln: Hi. My name's Maria Lincoln. I understand you hire out rooms in the community center as venues for parties?

Staff Member (Pete): Yes. We do. We vary a sized accommodation. It depends on what you're looking for, really.

Maria Lincoln: We're looking to hold a party, a children's birthday party, and we need a room that will hold about 70 people, with space for a small disco area, games, dancing, and food.

Staff Member (Pete): Well, we have a large room, and it would certainly hold at least a 100 people comfortably. It's used a lot for parties and things like that.

Maria Lincoln: That sounds as if it might be suitable. I've tried various venues, and they're either booked up or they don't hold enough people.

Staff Member (Pete): Can you tell me when you were thinking of holding the party?

Maria Lincoln: I know it's short notice, but we wanted to hold it Saturday week. That's September 15.

Staff Member (Pete): Let's have a look. Yes. You're in luck. The Mandela suite is free then.

Maria Lincoln: I'll just write that down. M A N D E L A.

Staff Member (Pete): And the time. When were you thinking of holding it?

Maria Lincoln: In the afternoon from 3:30PM to 9PM.

Staff Member (Pete): Yes. Okay. There is no smoking on the premises, and we're only licensed to have soft drinks.

Maria Lincoln: That's okay. I think I'm happy to go ahead.

Staff Member (Pete):Can you just give your postcode?

Maria Lincoln: Yes. It's PA57GJ.

Staff Member (Pete): Fine. And the flat and street number?

Maria Lincoln: It's Flat Number 40, and the street number is 35.

Staff Member (Pete): Okay. So that's Flat 4035 Beaches Street.

Maria Lincoln: Yes. That's right.

Staff Member (Pete): And a contact number?

Maria Lincoln: My landline is 223279 with the code, but I'll give you my mobile number, which is 07897293381.

Staff Member (Pete): Okay. 293381.

Maria Lincoln: Can you tell me how much it will cost?

Staff Member (Pete): It's quite reasonable, actually. It's a £115 for the hire of the room with tables and chairs. But if you want to hire disco equipment, we've got a basic system with speakers and other equipment for £25, but there is no technician around in case anything goes wrong. And, of course, it's optional.

Maria Lincoln: That would save us carting something from home, but maybe we should bring a spare sound system just in case.

Staff Member (Pete): We've never had any problem with the system, but you might not want to take any chances. What about catering?

Maria Lincoln: Well, we had thought of getting everyone bringing something.

Staff Member (Pete): We have someone who can do catering for £9 a head, including the cake if required.

Maria Lincoln: That's handy, but it's a lot as we have a fairly tight budget.

Staff Member (Pete): So you wanna go ahead with the booking?

Maria Lincoln: Yes. Certainly.

Staff Member (Pete): Okay. I need to take a deposit of £30, which is refundable. The balance needs to be paid two days before the event at the latest.

Maria Lincoln: Fine.

Staff Member (Pete): You can cancel up to two days before, but after that, you lose the deposit.

Maria Lincoln: We don't intend to cancel, but is there any insurance we can take out?

Staff Member (Pete): Yes. There's a a form here somewhere.

Maria Lincoln: How much?

Staff Member (Pete): It's oh, let me see. It's only £9 for the twenty four hour period, and that covers you for cancellation, damage, and injury.

Maria Lincoln: Well, at least we'd better have a look at it.

Staff Member (Pete): How would you like to pay the deposit?

Maria Lincoln: Cash.

Staff Member (Pete): I'll just give you a receipt.

Maria Lincoln: Uh-huh. There you are. $10, 20, 30.

Staff Member (Pete): £30. Maria Lincoln.

Maria Lincoln: Thank you very much. I'm really glad I found somewhere. We have been trying to book a place for the past two weeks, so thank you again and bye for now.
